why: Builds every session in Classic whatever the player stored, the pre-#1058 behavior (issue #1058; modelled on loop-renderer-ignores-the-stored-quality-preset): the Settings control writes the palette, the store persists it, the page paints it back, and no session ever draws in it. A player can find the control, choose High contrast, watch the button agree, and never see it. Since issue #1100 removed the `ownerPalette` developer flag, the setting is the only way a session reaches High contrast. The only witness is what the renderer, the stock chips and the death vignette were handed.
killedBy: startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default threads the stored owner palette to every reader, once per session (issues #1057, #1058) hands the renderer and the stock HUD the SAME palette the setting names, before any status
startGameWith: a real player death reaches the HUD flashes a two-player FFA death in the session's owner palette (issue #1057)
startGameWith: the Player colors setting survives a reload (issue #1058) a High contrast choice made through the toggle reaches the next session's renderer and stock chips
